text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on it now, there are still 
areas I need to improve. It only shows my 
own inexperience...
choice_data_list:
Consistency is what counts. You gave it 
your all today.

Let's learn from our mistakes and win next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, we suffered a defeat, 
but we gave it everything we had.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will sincerely accept this result of my 
own inadequacy and use it as nourishment 
to move forward to the next step."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! There is only one thing left to 
achieve: victory."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I must determine what it 
is that I currently lack."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please, let us hold today's review meeting 
as soon as possible.
